6.description: [Blackrock Spire]Pending Restarts: Reworked the loot of all bosses in both Lower and Upper Blackrock Spire on all difficulties. Bosses now have proper loot table, rare spawns will no longer drop their entire loot table on kill, all bosses will now award correct currency, corrected a number of missing items from heroic difficulty, removed a number of unused items from bosses loot tables such as old ability tomes, all bosses inside Upper Blackrock Spire now drop 2 items up from 1.

0.description: Correctly Statted Heroic Held in Off-Hand items. Their stats will be available after you clear your cache.

Fixed an issue where 25 mobs inside of instances were still not dropping the correct heroic loot. (There are still more to fix, we are working through this to get this fixed asap)
Overlord Wyrmthalak will now correctly drop the same amount of items that other end bosses in Heroic Dungeons drop.
Alazzin the Shapeshifter in Dire Maul East will now correctly drop the same amount of items that other end bosses in Heroic Dungeons drop.
Vastly improved the stats on 40 different items within the heroic dungeons.
Bloodclot Band from Heroic Dungeon now has updated stats.
Second Wind on Heroic now has a 2 minute cooldown, down from 15 minutes on it's mana regeneration proc.
Applied a smart-scalar to the heroic dungeon items for their armor. Armor from heroic dungeons should now compare to other armor from their same item level tier.
Doubled the Dynamic Respawn rate for creatures in world.

6.description: [Dire Maul] [Pimgib] Pimgib, the Imp of Lethtendris no longer awards any loot. His loot is now part of Lethtendris loot.

Bosses now have proper loot table, Rare spawns will no longer drop their entire loot table on kill, all bosses will now award correct currency, corrected a number of missing items from heroic difficulty, removed a number of unused items from bosses loot tables such as old ability tomes, all bosses can now drop dire maul books.
